run_psyonic_gripper_demo: run the psyonic gripper demo that cycles through grasps, sine waves, and hand poses
do_grasps_n_iterations: do n iterations of a basic grasping motion with the psyonic robot hand
do_sine_wave_steps: move the psyonic robot hand fingers through a sine wave for n steps
do_peace_sign_pose: move the psyonic robot hand into a peace sign pose
do_rock_on_pose: move the psyonic robot hand into a rock on gesture pose
